contents.reason: This exercise develops the separate inner-measure formulation and requires a new inner-measure definition; no retained theorem on this pair or its declared downstream uses consumes that formulation.

contents.name: Exercise 20(a), Equality with the outer measure re-induced from the measurable restriction and existence of measurable covers

Exercise 21, Saturation of the Carathéodory measure induced by a premeasure
contents.reason: Saturation concerns locally measurable sets in non-sigma-finite measure spaces and is not used by extension, completion, regular-hull continuity, or the metric criterion developed here.

contents.name: Exercise 22(a), Under sigma-finiteness the full induced Carathéodory measure is the completion of the original measure
Exercise 22(b), In general the full induced measure is the saturation of the completion
contents.reason: The non-sigma-finite saturation theorem belongs to measure-algebra pathology; this pair records nonuniqueness but no downstream page declares saturated measures as a prerequisite.
